data.one_liner: Full-featured prebuilt UI kit for one-on-one and group voice and video calls with offline invitations.
data.what_it_does: Provides complete voice and video call functionality including UI components, business logic, online/offline call invitations, device detection, and screen sharing. Allows developers to add calling features to an app in minutes.
use_when: You need to quickly implement 1-on-1 or group voice and video calls in your Flutter app.
You want built-in online and offline call invitations, missed call handling, and dial-back functionality.
avoid_when: You require a custom call UI from scratch without any pre-existing component bundle or dependency on ZEGOCLOUD backend services.
Your project targets Android versions requiring lower than compileSdk 37 without upgrading.
strengths: Includes both business logic and fully functional UI components out of the box.
Supports advanced features such as screen sharing, beauty effects, audio routing, and offline call handling.
Extensive configuration options for customization of layouts, menu bars, and ringtones.
weaknesses: Tied to a specific proprietary third-party backend/service (ZEGOCLOUD).
Demands strict native version constraints like Android compileSdk 37.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting Android compileSdk to 37 and configuring permissions for camera, microphone, and notifications as specified by permission_handler and calling plugins.
data.minimal_example:
ZegoUIKitPrebuiltCall(
  appID: yourAppID,
  appSign: yourAppSign,
  userID: yourUserID,
  userName: yourUserName,
  callID: yourCallID,
  config: ZegoUIKitPrebuiltCallConfig.oneOnOneVoiceCall(),
)
